purpose: Make the Relationship standing-stock uplift follow Admiral's complete loyalty contract. Standing alone is insufficient: every projected tier must satisfy both the trader's minimum PMC level and minimum standing from db/base.json.
selectionRules: select the highest tier for which both minPmcLevel and minStanding are satisfied
high standing must never compensate for insufficient PMC level
high PMC level must never compensate for insufficient standing
if profile level or standing cannot be resolved, fall back to LL1 finite Baseline values
do not use sales volume as an Admiral loyalty gate
do not alter price, offer identity, TPL, quest gates or capability gates

diagnosticBoundary.futurePass: a profile receives only the highest tier whose level and standing thresholds are both satisfied
diagnosticBoundary.futureFailStandingOnly: a high-standing profile below the required PMC level receives that higher tier
diagnosticBoundary.futureFailLevelOnly: a high-level profile below the required standing receives that higher tier
diagnosticBoundary.futureFailUnknownProfile: an unresolved profile receives any uplift above LL1
